name: leafdesk
description: Open-source workspace of pages and databases with realtime collaboration and a built-in MCP server for AI assistants. Run it on your own server, or on your computer with the desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux.

paragraphs: An open-source, self-hostable workspace of pages and databases with realtime collaboration and a built-in MCP server, so AI assistants such as Claude can search, read and edit your workspace after you approve them over OAuth.
shown as table, board, calendar, gallery, list, timeline, chart or form, with relations, formulas and rollups; dashboards put numbers, charts and lists from several databases on a page.

what it may read or change; optional AI writing, AI properties, a chat that remembers what you tell it, reusable skills, and agents that work on database rows, with Anthropic, OpenAI, Google or a local model.
features: Pages and databases: a block editor with slash commands, and databases whose rows are pages,
Realtime and offline: edit together with live cursors, keep working without a connection.
Built for AI assistants: connect Claude or any other MCP client over OAuth 2.1 and approve
Bring your pages: import a Notion Markdown & CSV export, an Obsidian vault, a Trello board,
Ready for a team: teamspaces, page permissions, guests, single sign-on (OIDC, SAML), SCIM,

whatItDoes.text: An open-source, self-hostable workspace of pages and databases with realtime collaboration and a built-in MCP server, so AI assistants such as Claude can search, read and edit your workspace after you approve them over OAuth.

audience.text: Built for AI assistants: connect Claude or any other MCP client over OAuth 2.1 and approve

requirements.text: Then open and create an account; the first one administers the server.
an invitation link to people who don't have an account yet (or whose account's address was never verified: anyone can sign up with someone else's address), or turn on a join link anyone can use.
A device's subscription belongs to the sign-in it was made in: signing out, or the session being revoked or running out, stops it.

The catalog lives in src/lib/connection-catalog.ts: it lists only servers that, at that address, either publish OAuth metadata naming it that Leafdesk can sign in with, take an API key, or answer without any sign-in.
